title: Lemon Herb Chickpea Couscous
ingredients: 160 g small-grain DRY INSTANT couscous (not pearl couscous)
140 g washed red cherry tomatoes cut in half
130 g Lebanese cucumber cut into short small cubes
45 g pitted dark Kalamata olives, drained
ingredientsKo: 작은 알갱이 건조 즉석 쿠스쿠스 160g (펄 쿠스쿠스 아님)
fullMethod: Put exactly 160g uncooked fine-grain instant couscous into one medium-sized heatproof bowl. Do not use oversized pearl couscous, and no water or vegetables added yet.
Bring safe drinking water to a boil and add 190ml to couscous. Immediately cover and rest five minutes for absorption, without adding vegetables yet.
Uncover the hydrated couscous and fluff tiny individual grains gently with a fork. If too hot, move into one larger shallow bowl and let it cool briefly before vegetables.

Drain and rinse 180g canned chickpeas. Halve 140g rinsed cherry tomatoes, dice 130g Lebanese cucumber, drain 45g pitted Kalamata olives, chop 18g washed fresh parsley. Keep all separate from couscous.
Blend 25ml extra virgin olive oil, 25ml freshly squeezed lemon juice and 2g fine salt in one small cup, stir to an imperfect light yellow vinaigrette.

Gently fold drained chickpeas, halved tomatoes, diced cucumber, olives, parsley and lemon-oil dressing into all fluffed and cooled fine-grain couscous. Serve freshly mixed in a bowl, keep refrigerated at 5C or below if not eating.
fullMethodKo: 중간 크기 내열 볼에 일반 작은 알갱이 즉석 쿠스쿠스 160g을 계량한다. 펄 쿠스쿠스는 사용하지 않고 물이나 채소는 아직 넣지 않는다.
끓인 물 190ml를 쿠스쿠스에 붓고 바로 덮어 5분 불린다. 채소나 드레싱을 넣지 않는다.
불어난 쿠스쿠스를 포크로 가볍게 풀고 뜨거우면 넓은 볼에서 식힌다. 곡물은 잘게 흩어져 있고 채소는 아직 없다.
병아리콩 180g 헹구고 물기 제거, 방울토마토 140g 반으로, 오이 130g 작게 썰기, 씨 뺀 칼라마타 올리브 45g 물기 제거, 파슬리 18g 다지기. 쿠스쿠스와 아직 섞지 않는다.
쿠스쿠스에 병아리콩, 방울토마토, 오이, 올리브, 파슬리, 레몬 드레싱을 부드럽게 섞어 바로 먹는다.

stages.scene: STEP 3 ONLY, ONE SINGLE CANDID 3:2 FOOD PHOTO, NOT A COLLAGE: after soaking instant couscous in 190ml boiling water for five minutes, a medium off-white shallow ceramic bowl, firmly resting on warm pale ivory fine-speckled quartz, holds 160g now HYDRATED FINE INSTANT COUSCOUS. Thousands of tiny irregular light-golden grains around 1mm, softly swollen, slightly darker with a realistic gentle MOIST SHEEN and a few tiny steam traces, fluffy rather than dry raw sand. The liquid has ALREADY BEEN ABSORBED, so no standing water or soup. EXACTLY ONE ordinary stainless STEEL FORK with ONE HANDLE and FOUR TINES is naturally inserted into a small clump of wet grains at right-center, gently separating them, handle extending upper right supported by bowl rim. Little imperfect gaps and loosened grains around tines, no staged perfect ridges. No second fork, second handle, floating utensil, hands, vegetables, garnish, chickpeas, tomatoes, lemon, captions or frames. Natural real kitchen daylight; physically realistic.
